message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Block tokenCache:credentialAccess and backupHost:lateralMovement. Blocking tokenCache makes dbLogin and rdpLogin unreachable, so printServer and shareMount are unreachable. Blocking backupHost also prevents serviceAccount and codeRepo, while secretsManager requires backupHost and printServer, jumpHost requires dbLogin, and hypervisor requires dbLogin. Thus all four parents of crownData:exfiltrate are unreachable. Two blocks are necessary because there are two internally disjoint attack routes: one through shareMount → printServer → rdpLogin → tokenCache, and another through codeRepo → backupHost → browserStore → workstation."}
